taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew treatment. Southwestern Texas nativity is well supported, but the currently documented county in the project record is Val Verde, outside the project target-zone list.
look_here_first: Think low spreading grayish subshrub: stems can root at the nodes, leaves carry many small silky leaflets, and flowers are purple-violet.

project_inclusion.range_basis: The prior review locked Val Verde County, but Val Verde is outside the project's target-county list. Horticultural Kyle/Austin/San Antonio records are excluded from native county evidence.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification; preserve the HOLD.

best_field_traits: stems capable of rooting at nodes
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The mat-forming/subshrub habit and silky many-leafleted foliage are stronger field cues than flower color alone.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use the creeping/subshrub architecture, node-rooting tendency, and many small silky leaflets together.
